methodology.label: Methodology
methodology.title:
A reproducible protocol.
Not a subjective opinion.
methodology.desc: The AEGRYN Grade methodology is documented, versioned and audited. Every analyst follows the same protocol.

principles.title: Reproducibility
principles.desc: Two independent analysts applying the same protocol must reach the same grade within ±1 sub-code.

principles.title: Traceability
principles.desc: Every grade is digitally signed and blockchain-anchored. Any revision generates a new traceable version.

principles.title: Independence
principles.desc: Analysts have no financial interest in the assets they certify. Strict separation between certification and transaction.

principles.title: Revisability
principles.desc: A grade can be revised after documented improvement. The original grade remains visible in the history.

methodology.scoringDesc: Each dimension is scored 0–25 points. The total determines the grade according to a published table.
